accuracy_notes: Photo-informed original artwork: Barbonymus schwanefeldii, tinfoil-barb visual study. Animated tail and fins; not a scanned specimen or taxonomic identification model. The broad supplied Lampam label is interpreted as the photographed tinfoil barb, Barbonymus schwanefeldii (also widely spelled schwanenfeldii). Minute sensory barbels are unresolved in the selected photos and are not represented; this is an appearance study, not a complete anatomical specimen.

attribution.credit: Original Blender geometry and textures for this gallery. Reference photos guide appearance and are not embedded.
